}
function labPill(l){ var cls = (l === 'ERROR' || l === 'CORRECT') ? l : 'other'; var t = {ERROR: 'Error', CORRECT: 'Correct', READING_CHOICE: 'Reading choice', OFF_SIGNATURE: 'Off-signature', UNPARSEABLE: 'Unparseable'}[l] || l; return '<span class="pill ' + cls + '">' + t + '</span>'; }
function flagPill(score, thr, strict){ if (score === null || score === undefined) return '<span class="pill other">no score</span>'; var f = strict ? score > thr : score >= thr; return f ? '<span class="pill flag">flags error</span>' : '<span class="pill pass">passes</span>'; }
function cFlag(r){ return r.c !== null && r.c >= 0.5; }
function jFlag(r){ return r.jd !== null && r.jd > RC.judge_threshold; }

/* ================= STEPPER ================= */
var STEP_SENT = (function(){ for (var i = 0; i < SENTS.length; i++) if (SENTS[i].text.indexOf('Anyone who works at a pool') === 0) return i; return 0; })();
var stepRows = bySent[STEP_SENT];
var stepCand = stepRows.filter(function(r){ return r.lab === 'ERROR' && r.jd === 0; })[0] || stepRows[0];
var stage = 0;
var STAGES = ['Sentence and candidate', 'Peer translations', 'Pairwise Z3 equivalence', 'Consensus score', 'Verdict vs. ground truth'];
var sel = $('#step-cand');
stepRows.forEach(function(r){ var o = document.createElement('option'); o.value = r.i; o.textContent = SLOTS[r.g].slot + ' · ' + sysName(r.g) + ' (' + (r.lab === 'ERROR' ? 'error' : r.lab === 'CORRECT' ? 'correct' : r.lab.toLowerCase()) + ')'; if (r === stepCand) o.selected = true; sel.appendChild(o); });
sel.addEventListener('change', function(){ stepCand = ROWS[+sel.value]; renderStep(); });
var markers = $('#step-markers');
STAGES.forEach(function(s, i){ var li = document.createElement('li'); var b = document.createElement('button'); b.type = 'button'; b.textContent = (i + 1) + '. ' + s; b.addEventListener('click', function(){ stage = i; renderStep(); }); li.appendChild(b); markers.appendChild(li); });
$('#step-prev').addEventListener('click', function(){ if (stage > 0){ stage--; renderStep(); } });
$('#step-next').addEventListener('click', function(){ if (stage < STAGES.length - 1){ stage++; renderStep(); } });
$('#stepper').addEventListener('keydown', function(e){
  if (e.target.tagName === 'SELECT' || e.target.tagName === 'INPUT') return;
  if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' && stage < STAGES.length - 1){ stage++; renderStep(); e.preventDefault(); }
  if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' && stage > 0){ stage--; renderStep(); e.preventDefault(); }
});
function drawPipeline(){
  var c = $('#step-diagram'), W = cw(c), narrow = W < 640;
  var n = STAGES.length, short = ['Sentence + candidate', 'k peer translations', 'Z3: equivalent?', 'Score c', 'Flag if c ≥ 0.5'];
  var H = narrow ? 64 : 76, svg = newSvg(c, W, H);
  var gap = narrow ? 8 : 18, bw = (W - gap * (n - 1)) / n;
  for (var i = 0; i < n; i++){
    var x = i * (bw + gap), on = i === stage, done = i < stage;
    var g = el('g', {style: 'cursor:pointer'}, svg);
    el('rect', {x: x + 1, y: 8, width: bw - 2, height: H - 16, rx: 8, fill: on ? 'var(--accent)' : (done ? 'var(--accent-soft)' : '#fff'), stroke: on || done ? 'var(--accent)' : '#c9ccd1', 'stroke-width': 1.5}, g);
    var t1 = txt(g, x + bw / 2, narrow ? H / 2 + 5 : H / 2 - 3, narrow ? String(i + 1) : 'Step ' + (i + 1), {'text-anchor': 'middle', style: 'font-weight:700;font-size:' + (narrow ? 16 : 12) + 'px;fill:' + (on ? '#fff' : 'var(--ink2)')});
    if (!narrow){
      var t2 = txt(g, x + bw / 2, H / 2 + 14, short[i], {'text-anchor': 'middle', style: 'font-size:13px;fill:' + (on ? '#fff' : 'var(--ink)')});
      var fs = 13; while (t2.getComputedTextLength() > bw - 12 && fs > 9){ fs -= 0.5; t2.style.fontSize = fs + 'px'; }
    }
    if (i < n - 1) el('path', {d: 'M' + (x + bw + 2) + ' ' + H / 2 + ' l' + (gap - 6) + ' 0 m-5 -4 l5 4 l-5 4', stroke: '#9aa0a8', fill: 'none', 'stroke-width': 1.5}, svg);
    (function(k){ g.addEventListener('click', function(){ stage = k; renderStep(); }); })(i);
  }
}
function renderStep(){
  var r = stepCand, S = SENTS[r.s], ps = peersOf(r), same = bySent[r.s].filter(function(q){ return q !== r && fam(q) === fam(r); });
  var valid = ps.filter(function(q){ return q.p; }), eq = valid.filter(function(q){ return r.k >= 0 && q.k === r.k; });
  var c = valid.length ? 1 - eq.length / valid.length : null;
  $$('button', markers).forEach(function(b, i){ if (i === stage) b.setAttribute('aria-current', 'step'); else b.removeAttribute('aria-current'); });
  $('#step-prev').disabled = stage === 0; $('#step-next').disabled = stage === STAGES.length - 1;
  $('#step-live').textContent = 'Stage ' + (stage + 1) + ' of ' + STAGES.length + ': ' + STAGES[stage];
  drawPipeline();
  var who = SLOTS[r.g].slot + ' (' + sysName(r.g) + ')';
  var candBox = '<code class="fol">' + esc(r.fol || '(no parseable output)') + '</code>';
  var inp = '', act = '', out = '', why = '';
  if (stage === 0){
    inp = '<p style="margin:0 0 8px">' + esc(S.text) + '</p><p class="note" style="margin:0">Template ' + S.tpl + ', ' + S.words + ' words, ' + S.nconds + ' conditions, clause type “' + esc(S.clause.replace(/_/g, ' ')) + '”.</p>';
    act = '<p style="margin:0 0 8px">Take the candidate produced by <b>' + esc(who) + '</b>. Nothing about a gold formula is used.</p>' + candBox;
    out = '<p style="margin:0">The pair (sentence, candidate). The metric’s job is to predict whether the candidate says what the sentence says.</p>';
    why = 'A gold formula is exactly what the operating setting lacks, so the metric must work from the sentence and other systems’ translations alone.';
  } else if (stage === 1){
    inp = '<p style="margin:0">The same sentence, translated at temperature 0 with a standard few-shot prompt by every generator slot. In this condition each prompt also lists the reference’s symbols.</p>';
    act = '<p style="margin:0 0 8px">Keep peers from <b>other vendors</b> only' + (same.length ? ' (dropping ' + same.map(function(q){ return SLOTS[q.g].slot; }).join(', ') + ', same vendor as the candidate)' : '') + '. Unparseable outputs are not counted.</p><ul class="peers">' + ps.map(function(q){ return '<li><span class="who">' + SLOTS[q.g].slot + '</span><code class="fol" style="padding:5px 8px">' + esc(q.fol || '(unparseable)') + '</code></li>'; }).join('') + '</ul>';
    out = '<p style="margin:0"><b>' + valid.length + '</b> parseable peer translations (the run recorded ' + r.np + ').</p>';
    why = 'Family diversity matters: independent vendors rarely make the same mistake, while correct translations converge on the same meaning.';
  } else if (stage === 2){
    var classes = {}; bySent[r.s].forEach(function(q){ if (q.k >= 0) (classes[q.k] = classes[q.k] || []).push(SLOTS[q.g].slot); });
    inp = '<p style="margin:0 0 8px">The candidate and each peer.</p>' + candBox;
    act = '<p style="margin:0 0 8px">Ask Z3 whether candidate and peer are logically equivalent (here the symbols are shared, so no alignment is needed).</p><ul class="peers">' + ps.map(function(q){ var m = !q.p ? '<span class="eqm x" aria-label="not counted">–</span>' : (q.k === r.k && r.k >= 0 ? '<span class="eqm y" aria-label="equivalent">=</span>' : '<span class="eqm n" aria-label="not equivalent">≠</span>'); return '<li>' + m + '<span><span class="who">' + SLOTS[q.g].slot + ' · ' + esc(sysName(q.g)) + '</span></span></li>'; }).join('') + '</ul>';
    out = '<p style="margin:0 0 6px"><b>' + eq.length + ' of ' + valid.length + '</b> peers are equivalent to the candidate.</p><p class="note" style="margin:0">Z3 splits all ten translations into ' + Object.keys(classes).length + ' equivalence classes: ' + Object.keys(classes).map(function(k){ return '{' + classes[k].join(', ') + '}'; }).join(' ') + '.</p>';
    why = 'Equivalence is semantic: two formulas written differently but meaning the same thing count as agreement, so harmless rewrites never lower the score.';
  } else if (stage === 3){
    inp = '<p style="margin:0">' + eq.length + ' agreeing peers out of ' + valid.length + '.</p>';
    act = '<p style="margin:0 0 6px">c = 1 − (agreeing peers) / (peers) = 1 − ' + eq.length + '/' + valid.length + '</p>';
    out = '<p style="margin:0 0 4px">Consensus score <b>c = ' + f3(c) + '</b> (recorded in the run: ' + f3(r.c) + ').</p><div class="scorebar" aria-hidden="true"><span style="width:' + (100 * c) + '%;background:var(--accent)"></span><i></i></div><p class="note" style="margin:0">0 = every peer agrees; 1 = no peer agrees. Tick marks the 0.5 threshold.</p>';
    why = 'The graded score keeps partial agreement. On Dataset E the graded score beats a binary majority vote by +0.114 [0.091, 0.140] stratified AUROC.';
  } else {
    var truth = r.lab === 'ERROR' ? 'an <b>error</b>' + (r.ops ? ' (repair needed: ' + esc(r.ops) + ')' : '') : r.lab === 'CORRECT' ? '<b>correct</b>, matching the ' + esc(r.rd) + ' reading' : '<b>' + esc(r.lab.toLowerCase().replace('_', ' ')) + '</b>';
    inp = '<p style="margin:0 0 6px">Consensus c = ' + f3(r.c) + ' ' + flagPill(r.c, 0.5) + '</p><p style="margin:0">Cheap judge, disguised text: ' + (r.jd === null ? 'no score' : f3(r.jd)) + ' ' + flagPill(r.jd, 0.5, true) + '</p>';
    act = '<p style="margin:0 0 8px">Compare both with the label: Z3 equivalence to the reference readings, which consensus never saw.</p><p style="margin:0 0 4px" class="note">Weak reading</p><code class="fol" style="padding:5px 8px">' + esc(S.weak || '') + '</code><p style="margin:6px 0 4px" class="note">Strong reading</p><code class="fol" style="padding:5px 8px">' + esc(S.strong || '') + '</code>';
    out = '<p style="margin:0">The candidate is ' + truth + '.</p>';
    var cRight = r.lab === 'ERROR' ? cFlag(r) : r.lab === 'CORRECT' ? !cFlag(r) : null;
    var jRight = r.jd === null ? null : r.lab === 'ERROR' ? jFlag(r) : r.lab === 'CORRECT' ? !jFlag(r) : null;
    why = 'Consensus is ' + (cRight === null ? 'not scored against a binary label here' : cRight ? 'right' : 'wrong') + ' on this candidate; the judge is ' + (jRight === null ? 'not scored' : jRight ? 'right' : 'wrong') + '.';
  }
  $('#step-body').innerHTML = '<div class="stagebox"><div><h4>What goes in</h4>' + inp + '</div><div><h4>What is done</h4>' + act + '</div><div><h4>What comes out</h4>' + out + '</div></div><p style="margin:12px 0 0"><b>Why:</b> ' + why + '</p>';
  var take;
  if (r.lab === 'ERROR') take = who + ' wrote an erroneous formula; ' + eq.length + ' of ' + valid.length + ' peers reproduce it, so c = ' + f3(r.c) + (cFlag(r) ? ' and consensus flags it' : ' and consensus misses it') + ', while the disguised judge ' + (r.jd === null ? 'returned no score' : jFlag(r) ? 'also flags it' : 'passes it (score ' + f3(r.jd) + ')') + '.';
  else if (r.lab === 'CORRECT') take = who + ' is correct (' + r.rd + ' reading); ' + eq.length + ' of ' + valid.length + ' peers agree, so c = ' + f3(r.c) + (cFlag(r) ? ', a false alarm: most peers chose the other accepted reading.' : ' and consensus passes it.');
  else take = who + ' is labelled ' + r.lab.toLowerCase().replace('_', ' ') + ' and is outside the primary comparison.';
  $('#step-take').textContent = take;
}

/* ================= ITEM BROWSER ================= */
var tplSel = $('#ib-tpl');
Object.keys(BK.template_clause).sort(function(a, b){ return +a.slice(1) - +b.slice(1); }).forEach(function(t){ var o = document.createElement('option'); o.value = t; o.textContent = t + ' (' + BK.template_clause[t].replace(/_/g, ' ') + ')'; tplSel.appendChild(o); });
var ibShown = 60, ibSel = null, ibList = [];
function ibFilter(){
  var f = $('#ib-filter').value, t = tplSel.value, q = $('#ib-q').value.trim().toLowerCase(), so = $('#ib-sort').value;
  var out = ROWS.filter(function(r){
    if (t !== 'all' && SENTS[r.s].tpl !== t) return false;
    if (f === 'ERROR' || f === 'CORRECT'){ if (r.lab !== f) return false; }
    else if (f === 'disagree'){ if (!isPrimary(r) || cFlag(r) === jFlag(r)) return false; }
    else if (f === 'judgemiss'){ if (!(r.lab === 'ERROR' && r.jd !== null && !jFlag(r))) return false; }
    else if (f === 'fa'){ if (!(r.lab === 'CORRECT' && cFlag(r))) return false; }
    else if (f === 'cmiss'){ if (!(r.lab === 'ERROR' && !cFlag(r))) return false; }
    else if (f === 'other'){ if (r.lab === 'ERROR' || r.lab === 'CORRECT') return false; }
    if (q && SENTS[r.s].text.toLowerCase().indexOf(q) < 0 && (r.fol || '').toLowerCase().indexOf(q) < 0) return false;
    return true;
  });
  var key = function(r){ if (so === 'c') return r.c === null ? -1 : r.c; if (so === 'j') return r.jd === null ? -1 : r.jd; if (so === 'gap') return (r.c === null || r.jd === null) ? -9 : r.c - r.jd; return -r.i; };
  out.sort(function(a, b){ return key(b) - key(a) || a.i - b.i; });

function ibRender(resetSel){
  ibList = ibFilter();
  var ne = ibList.filter(function(r){ return r.lab === 'ERROR'; }).length, nc = ibList.filter(function(r){ return r.lab === 'CORRECT'; }).length;
  $('#ib-count').textContent = 'Showing ' + Math.min(ibShown, ibList.length) + ' of ' + nfmt(ibList.length) + ' matching candidates (' + nfmt(ne) + ' errors, ' + nfmt(nc) + ' correct, ' + nfmt(ibList.length - ne - nc) + ' other labels).';
  var ul = $('#ib-list'); ul.innerHTML = '';
  if (resetSel || ibList.indexOf(ibSel) < 0) ibSel = ibList[0] || null;
  ibList.slice(0, ibShown).forEach(function(r){
    var li = document.createElement('li'), b = document.createElement('button'); b.type = 'button';
    b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', r === ibSel ? 'true' : 'false');
    b.innerHTML = '<span class="meta">' + labPill(r.lab) + '<span>' + SLOTS[r.g].slot + ' · ' + esc(sysName(r.g)) + '</span><span>' + SENTS[r.s].tpl + '</span><span>c ' + f3(r.c) + '</span><span>judge ' + (r.jd === null ? 'n/a' : f3(r.jd)) + '</span></span><span class="snip">' + esc(SENTS[r.s].text) + '</span>';
    b.addEventListener('click', function(){ ibSel = r; $$('button', ul).forEach(function(x){ x.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'false'); }); b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'true'); ibDetail(); });
    li.appendChild(b); ul.appendChild(li);
  });
  if (!ibList.length) ul.innerHTML = '<li style="padding:14px" class="note">No candidate matches these filters.</li>';
  $('#ib-more').disabled = ibShown >= ibList.length;
  ibDetail(); ibTake(ne, nc);
}
function ibDetail(){
  var d = $('#ib-detail'), r = ibSel;
  if (!r){ d.innerHTML = '<p class="note">Nothing selected.</p>'; return; }

'<code class="fol">' + esc(mp.row.fol) + '</code><p class="note" style="margin:4px 0 0">' + (inMaj ? 'The candidate is in this majority class.' : 'Not equivalent to the candidate.') + '</p>' : '<p class="note">No parseable peer.</p>') + '</div></div>' +
    '<div class="side" style="margin-top:12px"><div><h4>Consensus (method)</h4><p style="margin:0">c = <b>' + f3(r.c) + '</b> ' + flagPill(r.c, 0.5) + '</p><p class="note" style="margin:2px 0 0">' + (r.np === null ? '' : r.ne + ' of ' + r.np + ' peers equivalent') + '</p></div>' +

function ibTake(ne, nc){

/* ================= BREAKDOWN ================= */
function bkLabel(by, k){

  if (by === 'word_tercile') return {W1: 'Shortest third', W2: 'Middle third', W3: 'Longest third'}[k] || k;
  if (by === 'nconds_bin') return k + ' conditions';
  return k;
}
function renderBK(){
  var by = $('#bk-by').value, rows = BK[by];
  pairs($('#bk-chart'), rows.map(function(r){ return {label: bkLabel(by, r.key), a: {value: r.c, ci: r.c_ci, tip: nfmt(r.n) + ' candidates (' + r.n_error + ' errors)'}, b: {value: r.j, ci: r.j_ci, tip: nfmt(r.j_n) + ' judge-scored candidates'}}; }), {axis: 'Within-template AUROC (0.5 = chance)', aName: 'consensus', bName: 'disguised judge'});
  var gaps = rows.map(function(r){ return {k: bkLabel(by, r.key), g: r.c - r.j, r: r}; }).sort(function(a, b){ return a.g - b.g; });
  var ahead = rows.filter(function(r){ return r.c > r.j; }).length, sep = rows.filter(function(r){ return r.c_ci[0] > r.j_ci[1]; }).length;
  $('#bk-take').textContent = 'Consensus is ahead in ' + ahead + ' of ' + rows.length + ' slices, with non-overlapping CIs in ' + sep + '. The narrowest gap is ' + gaps[0].k + ' (' + f3(gaps[0].r.c) + ' vs ' + f3(gaps[0].r.j) + '); the widest is ' + gaps[gaps.length - 1].k + ' (' + f3(gaps[gaps.length - 1].r.c) + ' vs ' + f3(gaps[gaps.length - 1].r.j) + ').';
}

function renderK(){

  var svg = newSvg(c, W, 300), lo = 0.55, hi = 0.8;

  var x0 = ml, x1 = W - mr, y0 = mt, y1 = H - mb;

  el('line', {x1: x0, x2: x1, y1: y1, y2: y1, 'class': 'axis'}, svg);

  var band = 'M' + KC.map(function(d){ return sx(d.k) + ' ' + sy(d.band[1]); }).join(' L') + ' L' + KC.slice().reverse().map(function(d){ return sx(d.k) + ' ' + sy(d.band[0]); }).join(' L') + ' Z';
  el('path', {d: band, fill: 'var(--accent)', opacity: 0.16}, svg);
  var full = KC[KC.length - 1].auroc;

  el('line', {x1: sx(k), x2: sx(k), y1: y0, y2: y1, stroke: 'var(--ink)', 'stroke-width': 1, opacity: 0.35}, svg);
  el('path', {d: 'M' + KC.map(function(d){ return sx(d.k) + ' ' + sy(d.auroc); }).join(' L'), fill: 'none', stroke: 'var(--accent)', 'stroke-width': 2.5}, svg);
  el('path', {d: 'M' + KC.map(function(d){ return sx(d.k) + ' ' + sy(d.long); }).join(' L'), fill: 'none', stroke: 'var(--third)', 'stroke-width': 2, 'stroke-dasharray': '6 3'}, svg);
  KC.forEach(function(d){
    var g = el('g', {}, svg);

    el('circle', {cx: sx(d.k), cy: sy(d.auroc), r: d.k === k ? 7 : 5, fill: 'var(--accent)', stroke: '#fff', 'stroke-width': 1.5}, g);
    bindMark(g, '<b>k = ' + d.k + ', all candidates</b><br>mean AUROC ' + f3(d.auroc) + '<br>draw band ' + fci(d.band) + '<br>sentence-bootstrap CI ' + fci(d.ci) + '<br>$' + d.usd.toFixed(4) + ' per sentence', 'k ' + d.k + ', all candidates: ' + f3(d.auroc));
    var g2 = el('g', {}, svg);
    el('rect', {x: sx(d.k) - 10, y: sy(d.long) - 10, width: 20, height: 20, fill: 'transparent', 'class': 'hit'}, g2);
    el('rect', {x: sx(d.k) - 5, y: sy(d.long) - 5, width: 10, height: 10, fill: 'var(--third)', stroke: '#fff', 'stroke-width': 1.2}, g2);
    bindMark(g2, '<b>k = ' + d.k + ', longest third</b><br>mean AUROC ' + f3(d.long), 'k ' + d.k + ', longest third: ' + f3(d.long));
  });
  var d = KC[k - 1], dl = KC[KC.length - 1].long;
  $('#k-out').textContent = 'k = ' + k;
  $('#k-kpis').innerHTML = '<div class="kpi"><div class="k">AUROC, all candidates</div><div class="v acc">' + f3(d.auroc) + '</div><div class="s">' + pct(d.auroc / full) + ' of the 7-family ' + f3(full) + '</div></div>' +
    '<div class="kpi"><div class="k">AUROC, longest third</div><div class="v">' + f3(d.long) + '</div><div class="s">' + pct(d.long / dl) + ' of its own 7-family ' + f3(dl) + '</div></div>' +
    '<div class="kpi"><div class="k">Peer generation cost</div><div class="v">$' + d.usd.toFixed(4) + '</div><div class="s">per sentence</div></div>';
  var t = k === 1 ? 'A single peer family already gives AUROC ' + f3(d.auroc) + ', but each added family helps.' :
    'With ' + k + ' families consensus reaches ' + f3(d.auroc) + ' (' + pct(d.auroc / full) + ' of the full pool) at $' + d.usd.toFixed(4) + ' per sentence; long sentences are at ' + pct(d.long / dl) + ' of their own ceiling' + (d.long / dl < 0.96 ? ', so they need more families.' : '.');

$('#k-range').addEventListener('input', renderK);

/* ================= TRY IT ================= */
var slotBox = $('#try-slots'), inPool = SLOTS.map(function(){ return true; });
SLOTS.forEach(function(s, i){ var l = document.createElement('label'); l.className = 'check'; l.innerHTML = '<input type="checkbox" checked data-slot="' + i + '"> ' + s.slot + ' ' + esc(s.system.split('/')[1]); slotBox.appendChild(l); });
$$('input', slotBox).forEach(function(cb){ cb.addEventListener('change', function(){ inPool[+cb.getAttribute('data-slot')] = cb.checked; renderTry(); }); });
$$('[data-preset]').forEach(function(b){ b.addEventListener('click', function(){
  var p = b.getAttribute('data-preset');
  var want = p === 'all' ? null : ['deepseek', 'microsoft', 'openai'];
  $$('input', slotBox).forEach(function(cb){ var i = +cb.getAttribute('data-slot'); cb.checked = want ? want.indexOf(SLOTS[i].family) >= 0 : true; inPool[i] = cb.checked; });
  renderTry();
}); });
$('#thr').addEventListener('input', renderTry);
function poolScore(r){
  var ps = bySent[r.s].filter(function(q){ return q !== r && q.p && inPool[q.g] && fam(q) !== fam(r); });
  if (!ps.length) return null;
  var eq = ps.filter(function(q){ return r.k >= 0 && q.k === r.k; }).length;
  return 1 - eq / ps.length;
}
function wtAuroc(rows, key){
  var byT = {}; rows.forEach(function(r){ var v = key(r); if (v === null) return; (byT[SENTS[r.s].tpl] = byT[SENTS[r.s].tpl] || []).push([v, r.lab === 'ERROR']); });
  var num = 0, den = 0;
  Object.keys(byT).forEach(function(t){
    var arr = byT[t], E = arr.filter(function(a){ return a[1]; }).map(function(a){ return a[0]; }), C = arr.filter(function(a){ return !a[1]; }).map(function(a){ return a[0]; });
    C.sort(function(a, b){ return a - b; });
    E.forEach(function(e){ var lo = 0, hi = C.length; while (lo < hi){ var m = (lo + hi) >> 1; if (C[m] < e) lo = m + 1; else hi = m; } var less = lo; var hi2 = lo; while (hi2 < C.length && C[hi2] === e) hi2++; num += less + 0.5 * (hi2 - less); den += C.length; });
  });
  return den ? num / den : null;
}
var judgeWT = wtAuroc(PRIM, function(r){ return r.jd; });
function renderTry(){
  var thr = +$('#thr').value; $('#thr-out').textContent = thr.toFixed(2);
  var nPool = inPool.filter(Boolean).length;
  var sc = PRIM.map(function(r){ return {r: r, v: poolScore(r)}; });
  var scored = sc.filter(function(x){ return x.v !== null; }), dropped = sc.length - scored.length;
  var au = wtAuroc(scored.map(function(x){ return x.r; }), function(r){ return poolScore(r); });
  var E = scored.filter(function(x){ return x.r.lab === 'ERROR'; }), C = scored.filter(function(x){ return x.r.lab === 'CORRECT'; });
  var tp = E.filter(function(x){ return x.v >= thr; }).length, fp = C.filter(function(x){ return x.v >= thr; }).length;
  var rec = E.length ? tp / E.length : 0, fa = C.length ? fp / C.length : 0, prec = (tp + fp) ? tp / (tp + fp) : 0;
  var jE = PRIM.filter(function(r){ return r.lab === 'ERROR'; }), jC = PRIM.filter(function(r){ return r.lab === 'CORRECT'; });
  var jrec = jE.filter(jFlag).length / jE.length, jfa = jC.filter(jFlag).length / jC.length;
  var exact = nPool === SLOTS.length && scored.every(function(x){ return Math.abs(x.v - x.r.c) < 1e-5; });
  $('#try-kpis').innerHTML =
    '<div class="kpi"><div class="k">Within-template AUROC (computed)</div><div class="v acc">' + (au === null ? 'n/a' : f3(au)) + '</div><div class="s">judge on same rows: ' + f3(judgeWT) + '</div></div>' +
    '<div class="kpi"><div class="k">Errors flagged (recall)</div><div class="v">' + pct1(rec) + '</div><div class="s">' + tp + ' of ' + E.length + '; judge ' + pct1(jrec) + '</div></div>' +
    '<div class="kpi"><div class="k">Correct flagged (false alarms)</div><div class="v">' + pct1(fa) + '</div><div class="s">' + fp + ' of ' + C.length + '; judge ' + pct1(jfa) + '</div></div>' +
    '<div class="kpi"><div class="k">Precision of a flag</div><div class="v">' + pct1(prec) + '</div><div class="s">' + nPool + ' slots in pool' + (dropped ? '; ' + dropped + ' candidates had no peer' : '') + '</div></div>';
  drawHist(scored, thr);
  var t = nPool === 0 ? 'With an empty pool no candidate has a peer, so nothing can be scored.' :
    (exact ? 'All ten slots: the recomputed scores equal the recorded ones on every candidate, and the AUROC is the paper’s ' + f3(au) + '. ' : 'With ' + nPool + ' slots the AUROC is ' + (au === null ? 'undefined' : f3(au)) + (au !== null ? ' (' + sg3(au - H.conditions[0].rows[0].value) + ' against the full pool)' : '') + '. ') +
    'At threshold ' + thr.toFixed(2) + ' consensus catches ' + pct(rec) + ' of errors while flagging ' + pct(fa) + ' of correct candidates; the judge, at its own verdict, catches ' + pct(jrec) + ' and flags ' + pct(jfa) + '.';
  $('#try-take').textContent = t;
}
function drawHist(scored, thr){
  var c = $('#try-chart'), W = cw(c), nb = 10;
  var bins = [], E = scored.filter(function(x){ return x.r.lab === 'ERROR'; }), C = scored.filter(function(x){ return x.r.lab === 'CORRECT'; });
  for (var i = 0; i < nb; i++) bins.push({e: 0, c: 0});
  var bi = function(v){ return Math.min(nb - 1, Math.floor(v * nb + 1e-9)); };
  E.forEach(function(x){ bins[bi(x.v)].e++; }); C.forEach(function(x){ bins[bi(x.v)].c++; });
  var maxS = 0; bins.forEach(function(b){ maxS = Math.max(maxS, E.length ? b.e / E.length : 0, C.length ? b.c / C.length : 0); });
  var hi = Math.max(0.1, Math.ceil(maxS * 10) / 10);
  var svg = newSvg(c, W, 280), H = W < 560 ? 250 : 290;
  var ticks = niceTicks(0, hi, hi > 0.5 ? 0.2 : 0.1), tl = ticks.map(function(v){ return Math.round(v * 100) + '%'; });
  var tw = measure(svg, tl, 'tick'), ml = 8 + 16 + 10 + tw + 8, mr = 12, mt = 10, mb = 52;
  svg.setAttribute('viewBox', '0 0 ' + W + ' ' + H); svg.setAttribute('height', H);
  var x0 = ml, x1 = W - mr, y0 = mt, y1 = H - mb;
  var sy = function(v){ return y1 - v / hi * (y1 - y0); }, sx = function(v){ return x0 + v * (x1 - x0); };
  ticks.forEach(function(v, i){ el('line', {x1: x0, x2: x1, y1: sy(v), y2: sy(v), 'class': 'gridl'}, svg); txt(svg, x0 - 8, sy(v) + 4, tl[i], {'class': 'tick', 'text-anchor': 'end'}); });
  txt(svg, 0, 0, 'Share of class', {'class': 'axt', 'text-anchor': 'middle', transform: 'translate(' + (8 + 12) + ',' + ((y0 + y1) / 2) + ') rotate(-90)'});
  var bw = (x1 - x0) / nb;
  bins.forEach(function(b, i){
    [[b.e, E.length, 'var(--err)', 'errors', 0], [b.c, C.length, 'var(--cor)', 'correct', 1]].forEach(function(s){
      var share = s[1] ? s[0] / s[1] : 0, x = x0 + i * bw + 3 + s[4] * (bw - 6) / 2, w = (bw - 6) / 2 - 1;
      var g = el('g', {}, svg);
      el('rect', {x: x, y: y0, width: w, height: y1 - y0, fill: 'transparent', 'class': 'hit'}, g);
      el('rect', {x: x, y: sy(share), width: w, height: Math.max(0, y1 - sy(share)), fill: s[2]}, g);
      bindMark(g, '<b>Score ' + (i / nb).toFixed(1) + ' to ' + ((i + 1) / nb).toFixed(1) + '</b><br>' + s[0] + ' of ' + s[1] + ' ' + s[3] + ' (' + pct1(share) + ')', s[3] + ', score bin ' + (i / nb).toFixed(1) + ': ' + s[0]);
    });
  });
  el('line', {x1: x0, x2: x1, y1: y1, y2: y1, 'class': 'axis'}, svg);
  var xt = niceTicks(0, 1, W < 460 ? 0.2 : 0.1);
  xt.forEach(function(v){ txt(svg, sx(v), y1 + 16, v.toFixed(1), {'class': 'tick', 'text-anchor': 'middle'}); });
  txt(svg, (x0 + x1) / 2, y1 + 40, 'Consensus score c (share of peers not equivalent)', {'class': 'axt', 'text-anchor': 'middle'});
  el('line', {x1: sx(thr), x2: sx(thr), y1: y0, y2: y1, stroke: 'var(--ink)', 'stroke-width': 2}, svg);
}

/* ================= FAILS ================= */
var failSel = 0, failPanels = [$('#fp-0'), $('#fp-1'), $('#fp-2')];
var setFailTab = tabKeys($('#fail-tabs'), function(i){ failSel = i; renderFail(); });
function renderFail(){ setFailTab(failSel); failPanels.forEach(function(p, i){ p.hidden = i !== failSel; }); [renderFA, renderES, renderTR][failSel](); }
function hbars(container, rows, o){
  var W = cw(container), narrow = W < 560, svg = newSvg(container, W, 100);
  var labW = narrow ? 0 : measure(svg, rows.map(function(r){ return r.label; }), 'lab') + 14;
  var vals = rows.map(function(r){ return pct(r.a) + ' vs ' + pct(r.b); });
  var valW = narrow ? 0 : measure(svg, vals, 'val') + 14;
  var rh = narrow ? 62 : 46, top = 8, x0 = narrow ? 14 : labW, x1 = W - (narrow ? 14 : valW);
  var yAx = top + rows.length * rh + 4, H = yAx + 48;
  svg.setAttribute('viewBox', '0 0 ' + W + ' ' + H); svg.setAttribute('height', H);
  var sx = xAxis(svg, x0, x1, yAx, 0, 1, W < 460 ? 0.25 : 0.1, o.axis, top);
  rows.forEach(function(r, i){
    var y0 = top + i * rh, ya = narrow ? y0 + 22 : y0 + 6, bh = narrow ? 16 : 15;
    if (narrow){ txt(svg, x0, y0 + 13, r.label, {'class': 'lab'}); txt(svg, W - 14, y0 + 13, vals[i], {'class': 'val', 'text-anchor': 'end'}); }
    else { txt(svg, labW - 12, y0 + rh / 2 + 4.5, r.label, {'class': 'lab', 'text-anchor': 'end'}); txt(svg, x1 + 12, y0 + rh / 2 + 4.5, vals[i], {'class': 'val'}); }
    [[r.a, r.an, r.ad, 'var(--accent)', o.aName, 0], [r.b, r.bn, r.bd, 'var(--base)', o.bName, 1]].forEach(function(s){
      var y = ya + s[5] * (bh + 2), g = el('g', {}, svg);
      el('rect', {x: x0, y: y, width: x1 - x0, height: bh, fill: 'transparent', 'class': 'hit'}, g);
      el('rect', {x: x0, y: y, width: Math.max(1, sx(s[0]) - x0), height: bh, fill: s[3]}, g);
      bindMark(g, '<b>' + esc(r.label) + ', ' + esc(s[4]) + '</b><br>' + s[1] + ' of ' + s[2] + ' correct candidates flagged (' + pct1(s[0]) + ')', r.label + ', ' + s[4] + ': ' + pct1(s[0]));
    });
  });
}
function renderFA(){
  var rows = ['weak', 'strong'].map(function(rd){
    var C = ROWS.filter(function(r){ return r.lab === 'CORRECT' && r.rd === rd; }), Cj = C.filter(function(r){ return r.jd !== null; });
    var a = C.filter(cFlag).length, b = Cj.filter(jFlag).length;
    return {label: (rd === 'weak' ? 'Weak reading' : 'Strong reading') + ' (' + C.length + ')', rd: rd, a: a / C.length, an: a, ad: C.length, b: Cj.length ? b / Cj.length : 0, bn: b, bd: Cj.length};
  });
  hbars($('#fa-chart'), rows, {axis: 'Share of correct candidates flagged as errors', aName: 'consensus', bName: 'disguised judge'});
  $('#fa-take').textContent = 'Computed from the records: consensus flags ' + pct(rows[1].a) + ' of correct strong-reading translations but ' + pct(rows[0].a) + ' of weak-reading ones. Its false alarms come from outvoted minority readings, not from noise; the judge’s false-alarm rate barely depends on the reading (' + pct(rows[1].b) + ' vs ' + pct(rows[0].b) + ').';
}

h2{font-size:24px}\ndl.gloss{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,220px) minmax(0,1fr);gap:8px 18px;font-size:16px}\ndl.gloss dt{font-weight:600}\ndl.gloss dd{margin:0;color:var(--ink2)}\n@media (max-width:640px){dl.gloss{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)} dl.gloss dd{margin-bottom:8px}}\n.prov li{margin-bottom:6px;font-size:15.5px}\n.sr{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0 0 0 0);white-space:nowrap}\n@media (max-width:600px){\n  body{font-size:17px}\n  .wrap{padding:0 16px}\n  section.block{padding:40px 0 22px}\n  .card{padding:12px}\n  .lede{font-size:18px}\n}\n</style>\n</head>\n<body>\n<a class=\"skip\" href=\"#main\">Skip to main content</a>\n<header class=\"top\">\n  <div class=\"wrap\">\n    <p class=\"eyebrow\">Interactive explainer</p>\n    <h1>Cross-Family Solver Consensus as a Gold-Free Faithfulness Metric for Natural-Language-to-Logic Translation</h1>\n    <p class=\"authors\">Autonomous research run</p>\n    <div class=\"links\">\n      <a class=\"btn primary\" href=\"https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-eff060-layered-gold-free-checks-for-logic@fork/run_An1uy2kF2SjZ/paper.pdf\">Read the paper (PDF)</a>\n      <a class=\"btn\" href=\"https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-eff060-layered-gold-free-checks-for-logic@fork/run_An1uy2kF2SjZ/report.pdf\">Read the full research report</a>\n      <a class=\"btn\" href=\"https://github.com/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-eff060-layered-gold-free-checks-for-logic/tree/fork/run_An1uy2kF2SjZ\">Code repository</a>\n    </div>\n  </div>\n</header>\n<nav class=\"sec\" aria-label=\"Sections\">\n  <ul>\n    <li><a href=\"#finding\">The finding</a></li>\n    <li><a href=\"#how\">How it works</a></li>\n    <li><a href=\"#evidence\">Explore the evidence</a></li>\n    <li><a href=\"#try\">Try it</a></li>\n    <li><a href=\"#fails\">Where it fails</a></li>\n    <li><a href=\"#about\">Glossary &amp; sources</a></li>\n  </ul>\n</nav>\n\n<main id=\"main\" tabindex=\"-1\">\n<!-- ================= FINDING ================= -->\n<section class=\"block\" id=\"finding\" aria-labelledby=\"h-finding\">\n<div class=\"wrap\">\n  <div class=\"grid2\">\n    <div>\n      <p class=\"q\">The question</p>\n      <h2 id=\"h-finding\">Can you tell a wrong logic translation from a right one without a gold formula?</h2>\n      <p class=\"lede measure\">A sentence can be formalised correctly in many ways, and gold formulas are scarce and often wrong. The paper's answer: ask several independent LLM families to translate the same sentence, and score the candidate by how many of their translations a solver finds <em>not</em> equivalent to it.</p>\n      <p class=\"measure\">This is <button class=\"term\" type=\"button\" data-term=\"consensus\">cross-family solver consensus</button>. On the pre-registered test (<span data-bind=\"sig-n\"></span> candidates from <span data-bind=\"sig-sent\"></span> long templated sentences under a <button class=\"term\" type=\"button\" data-term=\"sig\">shared symbol vocabulary</button>) it separates erroneous from correct candidates far better than a cheap LLM judge.</p>\n      <div class=\"bignum\" data-bind=\"sig-delta\"></div>\n      <div class=\"bigcap\"><button class=\"term\" type=\"button\" data-term=\"wtauroc\">Within-template AUROC</button> advantage over the <button class=\"term\" type=\"button\" data-term=\"disguised\">disguised</button> cheap judge, 95% CI <span data-bind=\"sig-delta-ci\"></span>. Consensus <span data-bind=\"sig-c\"></span> vs judge <span data-bind=\"sig-j\"></span>.</div>\n      <p class=\"measure note\">Only this shared-vocabulary test was confirmed on data independent of all development. When generators choose their own predicate names (Dataset E, a development set), the advantage shrinks to +0.099 [0.049, 0.146]. Switch conditions on the right to see both.</p>\n    </div>\n    <div class=\"card\" aria-labelledby=\"h-head-view\">\n      <h3 id=\"h-head-view\" style=\"margin-top:0\">Does the advantage hold under every condition the run measured?</h3>\n      <div role=\"tablist\" aria-label=\"Measurement condition\" id=\"head-tabs\"></div>\n      <p class=\"note\" id=\"head-meta\" style=\"margin-bottom:4px\"></p>\n      <ul class=\"legend\" aria-hidden=\"true\">\n        <li><span class=\"sw\" style=\"background:var(--accent)\"></span>Proposed (consensus)</li>\n        <li><span class=\"sw\" style=\"background:var(--base)\"></span>Baseline</li>\n        <li><span class=\"sw dash\"></span>Chance (0.5)</li>\n      </ul>\n      <div class=\"chart\" id=\"head-chart\" role=\"group\" aria-label=\"AUROC with 95% confidence intervals for the selected condition\"></div>\n      <div class=\"readout\" id=\"head-readout\"></div>\n      <p class=\"note\" id=\"head-note\" style=\"margin-top:8px\"></p>\n      <p class=\"takeaway\" id=\"head-take\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n    </div>\n  </div>\n</div>\n</section>\n\n<!-- ================= HOW ================= -->\n<section class=\"block\" id=\"how\" aria-labelledby=\"h-how\">\n<div class=\"wrap\">\n  <p class=\"q\">How it works</p>\n  <h2 id=\"h-how\">One real sentence, walked through the metric</h2>\n  <p class=\"measure\">The metric needs only the sentence, the candidate formula and peer translations. It never sees a reference formula. Below is a sentence from the long-sentence test set and the ten translations the run's generator slots produced for it. Pick any of them as the candidate and step through what the metric does.</p>\n  <div class=\"card\" id=\"stepper\" aria-labelledby=\"h-step\">\n    <h3 id=\"h-step\" class=\"sr\">Stepper</h3>\n    <div class=\"ctl\">\n      <label>Candidate being scored\n        <select id=\"step-cand\"></select>\n      </label>\n    </div>\n    <div class=\"stepper-diagram chart\" id=\"step-diagram\" aria-hidden=\"true\"></div>\n    <ol class=\"stage-list\" id=\"step-markers\" aria-label=\"Stages\"></ol>\n    <p class=\"sr\" aria-live=\"polite\" id=\"step-live\"></p>\n    <div id=\"step-body\"></div>\n    <div class=\"navrow\">\n      <button class=\"plain\" type=\"button\" id=\"step-prev\">&larr; Previous</button>\n      <button class=\"plain\" type=\"button\" id=\"step-next\">Next &rarr;</button>\n      <span class=\"note\">Left and right arrow keys also move between stages.</span>\n    </div>\n    <p class=\"takeaway\" id=\"step-take\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n  </div>\n</div>\n</section>\n\n<!-- ================= EVIDENCE ================= -->\n<section class=\"block\" id=\"evidence\" aria-labelledby=\"h-evidence\">\n<div class=\"wrap\">\n  <p class=\"q\">Explore the evidence</p>\n  <h2 id=\"h-evidence\">Every candidate from the confirmed test, and where the gap comes from</h2>\n\n  <h3 id=\"h-browser\">What does the metric say about one candidate, and does the judge agree?</h3>\n  <p class=\"measure\">All <span data-bind=\"rc-n\"></span> translations of the <span data-bind=\"rc-sent\"></span> R<sub>COMP</sub> sentences in the shared-vocabulary condition. Labels are Z3 equivalence to the sentence's reference readings. The consensus score and the disguised judge's score are both oriented so that higher means \"more likely an error\"; each flags at 0.5.</p>\n  <div class=\"ctl\" role=\"group\" aria-label=\"Item filters\">\n    <label>Show\n      <select id=\"ib-filter\">\n        <option value=\"all\">All candidates</option>\n        <option value=\"ERROR\">Errors (label)</option>\n        <option value=\"CORRECT\">Correct (label)</option>\n        <option value=\"disagree\">Consensus and judge disagree</option>\n        <option value=\"judgemiss\">Errors the judge passed</option>\n        <option value=\"fa\">Correct but flagged by consensus</option>\n        <option value=\"cmiss\">Errors consensus passed</option>\n        <option value=\"other\">Reading choice, off-signature, unparseable</option>\n      </select>\n    </label>\n    <label>Template\n      <select id=\"ib-tpl\"><option value=\"all\">All templates</option></select>\n    </label>\n    <label>Sort by\n      <select id=\"ib-sort\">\n        <option value=\"c\">Consensus score, high first</option>\n        <option value=\"j\">Judge score, high first</option>\n        <option value=\"gap\">Consensus minus judge</option>\n        <option value=\"sent\">Sentence order</option>\n      </select>\n    </label>\n    <label>Search sentence or formula\n      <input type=\"search\" id=\"ib-q\" placeholder=\"e.g. unless, Famous\" autocomplete=\"off\">\n    </label>\n  </div>\n  <p id=\"ib-count\" aria-live=\"polite\" class=\"note\"></p>\n  <div class=\"browser\">\n    <div>\n      <ul class=\"ilist\" id=\"ib-list\" aria-label=\"Matching candidates\"></ul>\n      <div class=\"navrow\"><button class=\"plain\" type=\"button\" id=\"ib-more\">Show 60 more</button></div>\n    </div>\n    <div class=\"detail\" id=\"ib-detail\" aria-live=\"polite\"></div>\n  </div>\n  <p class=\"takeaway\" id=\"ib-take\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n\n  <h3 id=\"h-break\">Does the gap hold in every template and at every length?</h3>\n  <p class=\"measure\">Each row is one slice of the primary population, with consensus and the disguised judge scored on the same candidates. Values are the run's recorded AUROCs with 95% sentence-clustered bootstrap CIs.</p>\n  <div class=\"ctl\">\n    <label>Slice by\n      <select id=\"bk-by\">\n        <option value=\"template\">Sentence template (T1 to T9)</option>\n        <option value=\"word_tercile\">Sentence length tercile</option>\n        <option value=\"nconds_bin\">Number of conditions</option>\n      </select>\n    </label>\n  </div>\n  <ul class=\"legend\" aria-hidden=\"true\">\n    <li><span class=\"sw\" style=\"background:var(--accent)\"></span>Consensus</li>\n    <li><span class=\"sw\" style=\"background:var(--base)\"></span>Cheap judge, disguised</li>\n    <li><span class=\"sw dash\"></span>Chance (0.5)</li>\n  </ul>\n  <div class=\"chart card\" id=\"bk-chart\" role=\"group\" aria-label=\"AUROC by slice\"></div>\n  <p class=\"takeaway\" id=\"bk-take\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n\n  <h3 id=\"h-k\">How many peer families does the metric need?</h3>\n  <p class=\"measure\">On Dataset E, the run drew 50 random subsets of <em>k</em> peer families for each of 2,014 candidates that had all seven other families available, and recomputed the pooled AUROC. Drag <em>k</em> to see what each extra family buys.</p>\n  <div class=\"ctl\">\n    <div class=\"lbl\"><span id=\"k-lab\">Number of peer families, k</span>\n      <div class=\"rangebox\"><input type=\"range\" id=\"k-range\" min=\"1\" max=\"7\" step=\"1\" value=\"3\" aria-labelledby=\"k-lab\" aria-describedby=\"k-out\"><output id=\"k-out\" for=\"k-range\"></output></div>\n    </div>\n  </div>\n  <ul class=\"legend\" aria-hidden=\"true\">\n    <li><span class=\"sw\" style=\"background:var(--accent)\"></span>All candidates (band: 2.5th to 97.5th percentile over draws)</li>\n    <li><span class=\"sw sq\" style=\"background:var(--third)\"></span>Longest third of sentences (&gt;26 words)</li>\n    <li><span class=\"sw dash\"></span>Full 7-family pool</li>\n  </ul>\n  <div class=\"chart card\" id=\"k-chart\" role=\"group\" aria-label=\"AUROC against number of peer families\"></div>\n  <div class=\"kpis\" id=\"k-kpis\"></div>\n  <p class=\"takeaway\" id=\"k-take\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n</div>\n</section>\n\n<!-- ================= TRY ================= -->\n<section class=\"block\" id=\"try\" aria-labelledby=\"h-try\">\n<div class=\"wrap\">\n  <p class=\"q\">Try it</p>\n  <h2 id=\"h-try\">Build your own peer pool and pick a threshold</h2>\n  <p class=\"measure\">The run kept the Z3 equivalence class of every translation. That is enough to recompute the consensus score exactly in the page: for each candidate, count the peers from other vendors that sit in its class. Untick generator slots to shrink the pool, move the threshold, and the scores, AUROC and error rates are recomputed on the <span data-bind=\"sig-n\"></span> primary candidates. With every slot ticked, the recomputed scores equal the recorded ones.</p>\n  <div class=\"card\">\n    <fieldset class=\"checks\" id=\"try-slots\"><legend>Peer pool (generator slots)</legend></fieldset>\n    <div class=\"ctl\">\n      <button class=\"plain\" type=\"button\" data-preset=\"all\">All ten slots</button>\n      <button class=\"plain\" type=\"button\" data-preset=\"three\">DeepSeek, Phi-4, GPT-4.1-mini</button>\n      <div class=\"lbl\"><span id=\"thr-lab\">Flag a candidate when its consensus score is at least</span>\n        <div class=\"rangebox\"><input type=\"range\" id=\"thr\" min=\"0.05\" max=\"1\" step=\"0.05\" value=\"0.5\" aria-labelledby=\"thr-lab\"><output id=\"thr-out\" for=\"thr\"></output></div>\n      </div>\n    </div>\n    <div class=\"kpis\" id=\"try-kpis\" aria-live=\"polite\"></div>\n    <ul class=\"legend\" aria-hidden=\"true\">\n      <li><span class=\"sw sq\" style=\"background:var(--err)\"></span>Erroneous candidates</li>\n      <li><span class=\"sw sq\" style=\"background:var(--cor)\"></span>Correct candidates</li>\n      <li><span class=\"sw line\" style=\"background:var(--ink)\"></span>Threshold</li>\n    </ul>\n    <div class=\"chart\" id=\"try-chart\" role=\"group\" aria-label=\"Distribution of consensus scores by label\"></div>\n    <p class=\"takeaway\" id=\"try-take\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n  </div>\n</div>\n</section>\n\n<!-- ================= FAILS ================= -->\n<section class=\"block\" id=\"fails\" aria-labelledby=\"h-fails\">\n<div class=\"wrap\">\n  <p class=\"q\">Where it fails</p>\n  <h2 id=\"h-fails\">Three ways consensus goes wrong</h2>\n  <div role=\"tablist\" aria-label=\"Failure mode\" id=\"fail-tabs\">\n    <button role=\"tab\" type=\"button\" id=\"ft-0\" aria-controls=\"fp-0\" aria-selected=\"true\">Correct but outvoted</button>\n    <button role=\"tab\" type=\"button\" id=\"ft-1\" aria-controls=\"fp-1\" aria-selected=\"false\" tabindex=\"-1\">Short sentences</button>\n    <button role=\"tab\" type=\"button\" id=\"ft-2\" aria-controls=\"fp-2\" aria-selected=\"false\" tabindex=\"-1\">Vocabulary bridges</button>\n  </div>\n  <div role=\"tabpanel\" id=\"fp-0\" aria-labelledby=\"ft-0\" class=\"card\">\n    <h3 style=\"margin-top:0\">Does consensus punish a correct translation that most peers did not write?</h3>\n    <p class=\"measure\">Some templates admit two accepted readings: a weaker one and a stronger one (for example, \"unless\" read as a one-way or a two-way condition). Both are labelled correct. Most peers write the weak one, so a correct strong-reading translation is outvoted. The bars count correct candidates flagged at score 0.5 or above, computed from the per-candidate records.</p>\n    <ul class=\"legend\" aria-hidden=\"true\">\n      <li><span class=\"sw sq\" style=\"background:var(--accent)\"></span>Consensus</li>\n      <li><span class=\"sw sq\" style=\"background:var(--base)\"></span>Cheap judge, disguised</li>\n    </ul>\n    <div class=\"chart\" id=\"fa-chart\" role=\"group\" aria-label=\"False-alarm rate by accepted reading\"></div>\n    <div class=\"navrow\"><button class=\"plain\" type=\"button\" id=\"fa-go\">Show these false alarms in the item browser</button></div>\n    <p class=\"takeaway\" id=\"fa-take\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n  </div>\n  <div role=\"tabpanel\" id=\"fp-1\" aria-labelledby=\"ft-1\" class=\"card\" hidden>\n    <h3 style=\"margin-top:0\">Does the advantage survive on short, simple sentences?</h3>\n    <p class=\"measure\">Dataset E strata, consensus against the disguised cheap judge on the same candidates (tiers A+B). L25: at least 25 words and 3 conditions; L20: long MALLS sentences; EXC: exception clauses; CTRL: short FOLIO sentences.</p>\n    <ul class=\"legend\" aria-hidden=\"true\">\n      <li><span class=\"sw\" style=\"background:var(--accent)\"></span>Consensus</li>\n      <li><span class=\"sw\" style=\"background:var(--base)\"></span>Cheap judge, disguised</li>\n      <li><span class=\"sw dash\"></span>Chance (0.5)</li>\n    </ul>\n    <div class=\"chart\" id=\"es-chart\" role=\"group\" aria-label=\"AUROC by Dataset E stratum\"></div>\n    <div class=\"tscroll\"><table class=\"data\" id=\"es-table\"><caption class=\"sr\">Consensus minus judge, per stratum</caption></table></div>\n    <p class=\"takeaway\" id=\"es-take\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n  </div>\n  <div role=\"tabpanel\" id=\"fp-2\" aria-labelledby=\"ft-2\" class=\"card\" hidden>\n    <h3 style=\"margin-top:0\">Can a smarter equivalence check fix vocabulary mismatch?</h3>\n    <p class=\"measure\">Each point is one way of deciding when two translations \"agree\" on Dataset E. Moving left means fewer errors endorsed by the majority (<button class=\"term\" type=\"button\" data-term=\"e\">error endorsement e</button>); moving down means fewer correct translations outvoted (<button class=\"term\" type=\"button\" data-term=\"d\">correct-candidate divergence d</button>). Lines join each variant to plain alignment, the frozen metric.</p>\n    <div class=\"ctl\">\n      <label>Stratum\n        <select id=\"tr-st\">\n          <option value=\"ALL\">All strata</option>\n          <option value=\"LONG\">Long pool</option>\n          <option value=\"L25\">L25</option>\n          <option value=\"L20\">L20</option>\n          <option value=\"EXC\">EXC</option>\n          <option value=\"CTRL\">CTRL (short)</option>\n        </select>\n      </label>\n    </div>\n    <ul class=\"legend\" aria-hidden=\"true\">\n      <li><span class=\"sw\" style=\"background:var(--accent)\"></span>Plain alignment (frozen V0)</li>\n      <li><span class=\"sw\" style=\"background:var(--base)\"></span>Rescored variants V1 to V5</li>\n      <li><span class=\"sw\" style=\"background:var(--err)\"></span>Gloss-gated check</li>\n      <li><span class=\"sw\" style=\"background:var(--ink)\"></span>Exact symbol names only</li>\n    </ul>\n    <div class=\"chart\" id=\"tr-chart\" role=\"group\" aria-label=\"Error endorsement against correct-candidate divergence\"></div>\n    <div class=\"tscroll\"><table class=\"data\" id=\"tr-table\"><caption class=\"sr\">Endorsement and divergence per variant</caption></table></div>\n    <p class=\"takeaway\" id=\"tr-take\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n  </div>\n\n  <h3>What the paper does not show</h3>\n  <ul class=\"limits measure\">\n    <li><strong>Free vocabulary is not confirmed.</strong> The only result confirmed on an independent test set is the shared-vocabulary long-sentence test. The Dataset E result met its pre-registered criterion but Dataset E was also used for development. A fresh 550-sentence set, a second long-sentence sample and R<sub>COMP</sub> under free vocabulary were all budget-stopped before reaching testability.</li>\n    <li><strong>Renames break it.</strong> Two formulas with different predicate names are never Z3-equivalent under an identity map. On the perturbation suite the nonce-rename false-alarm rate is 0.76.</li>\n    <li><strong>Shared mistakes are invisible.</strong> On Dataset E, 38% of errors are endorsed by the majority: 57% of structural errors but 5% of polarity errors. Text checks catch some of these, yet PEER+TEXT fusion does not significantly beat consensus alone (stratified +0.011, not significant).</li>\n    <li><strong>Every bridge trades one error for another.</strong> Name-free alignment, hybrid matching and gloss-gated checking each lower divergence and raise endorsement. The gloss-gated checker failed its development gate (0.696 vs 0.742). Giving peers the candidate's own symbols lowered d (0.139 vs 0.323) but raised e (0.459 vs 0.173), for AUROC 0.614 against 0.770.</li>\n    <li><strong>Templated text.</strong> The confirmed test uses templated sentences with a shared symbol list, which is narrower than real NL-to-FOL, where generators choose their own names.</li>\n  </ul>\n</div>\n</section>\n</main>\n\n<footer id=\"about\" aria-labelledby=\"h-about\">\n<div class=\"wrap\">\n  <h2 id=\"h-about\">Links, sources and glossary</h2>\n  <div class=\"links\" style=\"margin-bottom:26px\">\n    <a class=\"btn primary\" href=\"https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-eff060-layered-gold-free-checks-for-logic@fork/run_An1uy2kF2SjZ/paper.pdf\">Read the paper (PDF)</a>\n    <a class=\"btn\" href=\"https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-eff060-layered-gold-free-checks-for-logic@fork/run_An1uy2kF2SjZ/report.pdf\">Read the full research report</a>\n    <a class=\"btn\" href=\"https://github.com/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-eff060-layered-gold-free-checks-for-logic/tree/fork/run_An1uy2kF2SjZ\">Code repository</a>\n  </div>\n  <h3>Where each view's data comes from</h3>\n  <ul class=\"prov measure\" id=\"prov\"></ul>\n  <p class=\"note measure\">Every chart, count and table on this page is built in the browser from the JSON blocks embedded in this file, which a script extracted from the files named above. Quantities marked \"computed\" (threshold sweeps, filtered counts, the recomputed consensus scores) are computed from the embedded per-candidate records; all other values are printed as the files hold them.</p>\n  <h3>Glossary</h3>\n  <dl class=\"gloss\" id=\"gloss\"></dl>\n</div>\n</footer>\n<div id=\"chart-tip\" role=\"status\" hidden></div>\n<div id=\"tips\"></div>\n\n<script type=\"application/json\" id=\"data-headline\" data-source=\"experiment_7/results/analysis.json (SIG.primary, SIG.secondary, SIG.frontier); () => {

    for (let i = 0; i < ts.length; i++) for (let j = i + 1; j < ts.length; j++) {

    }
    // text outside svg box

    ts.forEach(x => { if (x.r.left < sr.left - 1 || x.r.right > sr.right + 1) out.push([svg.parentElement.id, 'OUTSIDE', x.t]); });
  });
  return out;
}

        pg.on('console', lambda m: errs.append(f'{m.type}: {m.text}') if m.type in ('error', 'warning') else None)

        print(tag, 'svgs', pg.evaluate("document.querySelectorAll('svg').length"), 'controls', pg.evaluate("document.querySelectorAll('button,select,input').length"))

            print(tag, 'head', i, pg.inner_text('#head-take')[:160])

        # hover a mark

        pg.locator('#finding').screenshot(path=str(SHOT / f'{tag}_term.png'))

        print(tag, 'term after esc hidden', pg.evaluate(f"document.getElementById('{tid}').hidden"))

            if s < 4: pg.click('#step-next'); pg.wait_for_timeout(80)
        print(tag, 'step take', pg.inner_text('#step-take'))

        print(tag, 'step take cand9', pg.inner_text('#step-take'))
        pg.locator('#step-markers button').nth(1).click(); pg.focus('#step-next'); pg.keyboard.press('ArrowRight'); pg.wait_for_timeout(50)
        print(tag, 'after arrow', pg.inner_text('#step-live'))

        for f in ['all', 'disagree', 'judgemiss', 'fa', 'cmiss', 'other', 'ERROR']:
            pg.select_option('#ib-filter', f); pg.wait_for_timeout(80)
            print(tag, 'ib', f, pg.inner_text('#ib-count'), '|', pg.inner_text('#ib-take')[:200])
        pg.select_option('#ib-tpl', 'T8'); pg.wait_for_timeout(50)
        print(tag, 'ib T8', pg.inner_text('#ib-count'))
        pg.fill('#ib-q', 'unless'); pg.wait_for_timeout(80)
        print(tag, 'ib q', pg.inner_text('#ib-count'))
        pg.fill('#ib-q', ''); pg.select_option('#ib-tpl', 'all'); pg.select_option('#ib-filter', 'judgemiss'); pg.select_option('#ib-sort', 'gap')
        pg.locator('#ib-list button').nth(2).click(); pg.wait_for_timeout(80)
        pg.locator('#h-browser').scroll_into_view_if_needed()
        pg.screenshot(path=str(SHOT / f'{tag}_browser.png'))
        pg.click('#ib-more'); print(tag, 'more', pg.inner_text('#ib-count'))
        # breakdown
        for v in ['template', 'word_tercile', 'nconds_bin']:
            pg.select_option('#bk-by', v); pg.wait_for_timeout(80)
            print(tag, 'bk', v, pg.inner_text('#bk-take'))
            print(tag, '  overlaps', pg.evaluate(OVERLAP_JS))
            pg.locator('#bk-chart').screenshot(path=str(SHOT / f'{tag}_bk_{v}.png'))
        # k
        for k in ['1', '3', '5', '7']:
            pg.fill('#k-range', k); pg.wait_for_timeout(60)
            print(tag, 'k', k, pg.inner_text('#k-take'))
        pg.locator('#k-chart').screenshot(path=str(SHOT / f'{tag}_k.png'))
        pg.locator('#k-chart .mark').nth(4).hover(); pg.wait_for_timeout(60); print(tag, 'k tip', pg.inner_text('#chart-tip')[:100])

        pg.locator('#try').scroll_into_view_if_needed()
        print(tag, 'try', pg.inner_text('#try-take'))
        pg.click('[data-preset="three"]'); pg.wait_for_timeout(200); print(tag, 'try3', pg.inner_text('#try-take'))
        pg.fill('#thr', '0.8'); pg.wait_for_timeout(200); print(tag, 'thr.8', pg.inner_text('#try-take'))
        pg.locator('#try .card').screenshot(path=str(SHOT / f'{tag}_try.png'))
        pg.click('[data-preset="all"]'); pg.fill('#thr', '0.5'); pg.wait_for_timeout(200); print(tag, 'try all', pg.inner_text('#try-kpis')[:200].replace('\n', ' '))
        pg.locator('#try-slots input').nth(0).click(); pg.wait_for_timeout(200); print(tag, 'try untick G1', pg.inner_text('#try-take')[:120])
        # fails
        for i in range(3):
            pg.click(f'#ft-{i}'); pg.wait_for_timeout(120)
            tk = ['#fa-take', '#es-take', '#tr-take'][i]
            print(tag, 'fail', i, pg.inner_text(tk))
            print(tag, '  overlaps', pg.evaluate(OVERLAP_JS))
            pg.locator(f'#fp-{i}').screenshot(path=str(SHOT / f'{tag}_fail{i}.png'))
        for st in ['LONG', 'CTRL']:
            pg.select_option('#tr-st', st); pg.wait_for_timeout(60); print(tag, 'tr', st, pg.inner_text('#tr-take'))
        pg.click('#ft-0'); pg.click('#fa-go'); pg.wait_for_timeout(200); print(tag, 'fa-go', pg.inner_text('#ib-count'))
        sw = pg.evaluate('document.documentElement.scrollWidth')
        print(tag, 'final scrollWidth', sw)
        pg.screenshot(path=str(SHOT / f'{tag}_full_end.png'), full_page=True)
        b.close()
    print(tag, 'CONSOLE', errs)

### [129] ASSISTANT · 2026-09-25 19:00:19 UTC

```
I built `interactive.html` and linked it from `index.html`. In headless Chromium at 390px, 1280px and 1440px every control works, with no console errors, no overlapping chart labels and no sideways scrolling.

**What the page does:**
- **The finding:** the headline result, +0.367 [0.328, 0.404] (consensus 0.954 vs the cheap judge's 0.587). Tabs switch between four measured conditions: the confirmed shared-vocabulary test, the same test against a judge that sees the original text, the 60-candidate frontier-judge subsample, and Dataset E, where predicate names are free and the gap shrinks to +0.099.
- **How it works:** a five-stage stepper on one real sentence ("Anyone who works at a pool… unless they study in the United States"). By default it scores Mistral's translation, which has a connective error: none of its 9 peers agree with it, so consensus flags it, while the disguised judge passes it with a score of 0.000. A dropdown lets you score any of the sentence's 10 translations, including correct ones that consensus wrongly flags.
- **Explore the evidence:**
  - an item browser over all 2,210 candidates with filters, search and sorting, showing each candidate beside what most peers wrote;
  - a chart of the gap by template, sentence length and number of conditions;
  - a slider over the number of peer families (1 to 7) on Dataset E.
- **Try it:** tick which generator models form the peer pool and move the flagging threshold. The score, AUROC, recall and false-alarm rate are recomputed live from the recorded equivalence classes. With all ten ticked it gives the paper's 0.954 exactly.
- **Where it fails:** three tabs:
  - correct translations of the less common reading get outvoted (96% of them flagged, against 14% for the common reading);
  - short sentences, where the advantage reverses (−0.069);
  - every alternative agreement rule lowers one error rate by raising the other, apart from two variants that improve both by a few hundredths at most.

  The paper's stated limitations follow.

**One thing you should know:** for Dataset E, the paper's Table 1 prints a few values that don't appear in the run's results file: the baseline stack at 0.704, the local judge at 0.669, and some confidence intervals. The page prints the file's values instead (0.735 and 0.674), which match the paper's Figure 2, and says so in a note under that tab. You may want to fix Table 1 in the paper.
